baseline: front end (M5 Step 14): e2e/perf Playwright runner + bundle report
note: Named web-meta.json (not meta.json) on purpose: scripts/perf_compare.py's pick_baseline() selects the newest directory that carries a meta.json for the k6 comparison, and this directory holds no k6 summaries.
appCommitNote: master at the end of M3; the app image was built from a scratch clone of that commit plus the uncommitted M5 tooling (e2e/perf, perf/web, perf/run.sh web, vite.config.ts VITE_API_TARGET) — no server or SPA source change, so the served SPA is the master SPA
dataset: perf/snapshots/lettuce-perf-v2-2026-10-01-s1-x1.0.dump, restored with perf/run.sh restore before the run (read-only loads; sign-ins add a few account_events rows)
command: perf/run.sh web all --run web1  (= every screen at 1x CPU, reviews-team-view again at 4x CPU, the bundle report; traces were written to the git-ignored results dir and are not committed)

runner.coldRun: iteration 0 of every case is reported separately under `cold`; medians are over the 5 measured iterations
runner.settled: every expected request finished + nothing in flight + no visible Loader/Skeleton + ready selector, stable for 400 ms; poll 25 ms

machine.cpu: Apple M5 Max (18 cores, 128 GB host)
machine.vm: 18 CPUs, 16 GB (shared by every container; the browser runs on the host)

caveat: one machine, loopback network, development-mode app image: milliseconds are relative, never production numbers; request/statement/transaction counts and byte sizes are exact
